# Lab 14.2: Multimodal Embeddings

## What We Are Going to Do
Put images and text in the same vector space, then search product photos with a text phrase.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Score images against a text phrase.** Uses `lab10.pet_images`.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT uri,
  AI.SIMILARITY('aquarium equipment', ref,
                endpoint =&gt; 'multimodalembedding@001', connection_id =&gt; 'us.lab_conn') AS score
FROM lab10.pet_images
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 5;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Store image embeddings.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE lab14.image_emb AS
SELECT uri, AI.EMBED(ref, endpoint =&gt; 'multimodalembedding@001', connection_id =&gt; 'us.lab_conn').result AS emb
FROM lab10.pet_images;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Search images with any text.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT base.uri, distance
FROM VECTOR_SEARCH(
  TABLE lab14.image_emb, 'emb',
  (SELECT AI.EMBED('toy for a cat', endpoint =&gt; 'multimodalembedding@001', connection_id =&gt; 'us.lab_conn').result AS emb),
  top_k =&gt; 3, distance_type =&gt; 'COSINE');</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[Console] Look at the results.** Use `OBJ.GET_ACCESS_URL` (Lab 10.6) on the top URIs and open the images. They match the phrase even though no text labels exist.

5. **[CLI] Check the image embedding table.**

</code></pre>

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Model | `multimodalembedding@001` |
| Shared space | Text and images comparable |
| Search | Text query finds images |
| No labels | Works on raw photos |
